chosen_policy.projection: Native orthographic through zoom 0.5; native perspective beyond that point. Smooth pitch/focus/logarithmic width interpolation, narrow-FOV matched-distance dolly, exact critically damped zoom and independent exponential follow.
chosen_policy.reason: The 70-degree framing-matched native switch failed. A narrow native FOV met the observed tolerance, so no custom view extension, generic blend, matrix override or new projection protocol was necessary.
chosen_policy.tradeoff: Default handoff is about 62 km from focus; physical camera distance is not monotonic while the displayed zoom closes. Long collision sweeps, production-world precision/occlusion/LOD/shadow behavior and performance remain T05/T06 acceptance.

Caps are distinguished from slower observed rendered rates.

Invalid handoff FOV rejected atomically with a visible reason. Defaults restored exactly and recovered after another restart; native invalid/serialization/bounds coverage passes.
